title: Hook 的公开用法与实现证据边界
excerpt: Hooks are user-defined shell commands. Claude Code runs them at specific points in its lifecycle, which gives you deterministic control: certain actions always happen
summary: 官方指南介绍在生命周期事件上运行用户定义的 Hook，并链接配置和协议参考。
